review.rationale: 来源35e1e75a三条各自独立递增，60/80/100/120封顶；新答临时上限刷新与不补HP已完整执行，只有真实离场移除延期。
review.singleBehavior: 实际使用攻击时速度面板乘容量比例刷新本源上限，不累加、不补当前HP；使用后当前已损HP乘独立比例附粉，回合初满HP授当回独立增红；技能未用、属性和药剂不增前两层。保留其他来源上限；速度能力等级不参与容量计算。
review.deferredBehavior: 在真实下场事件移除本魂印授予的临时体力上限；当前授予、刷新和HP同步已按用户确认实现，不归入延期。来源术语定义：未注明消失时点时，默认为精灵下场时。
review.trigger: 真正下场时，仅移除本魂印来源的临时上限
futureMechanisms: 真实下场事件与临时上限来源账本

success.assertion: test('4951/2151已答速度面板不含等级，临时上限同源刷新且当前HP不变，60至120独立递增',()=>{for(const rank of [-3,0,3]){const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000});s.fighters[0].stages.spe=rank;for(const rate of [60,80,100,120,120]){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9000+500*rate/100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.capacityBonus,500*rate/100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stages.spe,rank);}}});

success.name: 4951/2151已损HP附粉60至120独立递增封顶，属性与药剂不递增，粉免仍执行记录
success.assertion: test('4951/2151已损HP附粉60至120独立递增封顶，属性与药剂不递增，粉免仍执行记录',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000,loadout:[10001,20017,29468,29469,38572]});for(const rate of[60,80,100,120,120]){s.fighters[1].hp=9000;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(s,'percent'),(1000+s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.capacityBonus)*rate/100);}const before=s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate;turn(s,20017,20309);turn(s,null,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,before);const x=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000});timer(x,1,'固定百分比免疫');turn(x,10001,20309);assert.equal(sum(x,'percent'),0);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.damageRate,80);});

success.name: 4951/2151回合初满HP增红60至120独立封顶，后续失血不取消当回合增红，非满不增层
success.assertion: test('4951/2151回合初满HP增红60至120独立封顶，后续失血不取消当回合增红，非满不增层',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true}),b=make({move:10001});for(const rate of[60,80,100,120,120]){for(const x of[s,b]){x.fighters[0].hp=x.fighters[0].stats.maxHp;x.fighters[1].hp=9000;x.rng=12345;}turn(s,10001,20309);turn(b,10001,20309);assert.ok(Math.abs(sum(s)/sum(b)-(1+rate/100))<.05);}const x=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8999});turn(x,10001,20309);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.fullRate,60);assert.equal(x.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.fullBonus,0);});

success.assertion: test('4951已答同源临时上限刷新保留其他上限增益，面板变化与向下取整不改当前HP，超过新上限合法钳制',()=>{const s=make({move:10001,soul:true,hp:8000,aStats:{spe:501}});turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9300);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp+=700;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,10100);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,8000);s.fighters[0].stats.spe=100;s.fighters[0].hp=10100;turn(s,10001,20309);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].stats.maxHp,9800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].hp,9800);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.wind2151.capacityBonus,100);});

success.name: 4951全部17招基础真实HP分类PP及原始优先级，真实14404三目标字段保留且当前单目标仅一包
success.assertion: test('4951全部17招基础真实HP分类PP及原始优先级，真实14404三目标字段保留且当前单目标仅一包',()=>{for(const m of source.moves){const s=make({move:m.id,index:-1,aStats:{atk:180,spa:18}});turn(s,m.id,20117);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)],m.pp-1);assert.equal(s.fighters[0].soulState.resolvedPriority.value,m.priority);const es=(s.damageEvents??[]).filter(e=>e.sourceSide===0&&e.type==='attack');assert.equal(es.length,m.kind==='status'?0:1,m.name);if(es.length){assert.equal(es[0].attackValue,m.kind==='physical'?180:18);assert.equal(s.fighters[1].hp,9000-es[0].hpLoss);assert.equal(es[0].settledDamage>0,m.power>0);}const z=make({move:m.id,index:-1});z.fighters[0].pp[key(m.id)]=0;assert.throws(()=>turn(z,m.id,20309),/有 PP/);}const m=source.moves.find(m=>m.id===14404),c=E.WIKI.compile(m,source);assert.equal(m.sourceTargetCount,3);assert.equal(c.ignoredSourceFeatures[0].value,3);});

success.assertion: test('4951/2299清回合成功才清敌攻击PP，PP保护与无回合失败，1640满HP必暴否则正常',()=>{for(const protect of[false,true]){const s=make({move:38572,index:0});const old=E.SOULS;E.SOULS={...old,trait(f,k){if(protect&&f.side===1&&k==='ppReductionImmune')return true;return old.trait(f,k);}};try{turn(s,38572,20309);}finally{E.SOULS=old;}assert.equal(s.fighters[1].pp[key(10127)],protect?s.moveDefinitions[key(10127)].pp:0);assert.ok(s.fighters[1].pp[key(20309)]>0);}const x=make({move:38572,index:0});x.fighters[1].effects={};turn(x,38572,20309);assert.ok(x.fighters[1].pp[key(10127)]>0);for(const hp of[8999,9000]){const s=make({move:38572,index:1,hp});turn(s,38572,20309);const e=s.turns[0].events.find(e=>e.damage?.sourceSide===0&&e.damage?.type==='attack');assert.equal(/× 暴击 2/.test(e.detail),hp===9000);}});
